label: projected-hub-work
sql: WITH removed AS (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,source_type,source_id,count(*) n FROM client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.delete_r1 GROUP BY ALL), added AS (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,source_type,source_id,count(*) n FROM client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.insert_r1 GROUP BY ALL) SELECT count(*)+sum(d.out_degree-coalesce(r.n,0)+coalesce(a.n,0)) FROM client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.insert_r1 i JOIN client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.out_degree_r1 d ON i.source_system=d.source_system AND i.rel_type_id=d.rel_type_id AND i.target_type=d.source_type AND i.target_id=d.source_id LEFT JOIN removed r ON d.source_system=r.source_system AND d.rel_type_id=r.rel_type_id AND d.source_type=r.source_type AND d.source_id=r.source_id LEFT JOIN added a ON d.source_system=a.source_system AND d.rel_type_id=a.rel_type_id AND d.source_type=a.source_type AND d.source_id=a.source_id
